_doc: Licensing inventory of everything the Windows release ships (LICENSE_AUDIT.md). tools/check_license_inventory.py fails when a shipped asset file or a bundled Python package has no entry here. Status: verified (rights and obligations established), conditional (distributable once the listed obligations are met), unresolved (rights not established), not_distributable (not distributable as currently packaged). The check never decides legal compatibility.

assets.name: Road Rage Trip game code
assets.purpose: the game client and simulation server

assets.name: OpenStreetMap places database
assets.purpose: airports and railway stations (244 entries with their OSM ids)
assets.obligations: attribution where the data is used; the derived database stays under ODbL with a notice; offer the database (it ships in the release)
assets.remediation: in-game attribution (Credits, map views: done); ODbL notice in DATA_LICENSES.txt (present)

assets.name: Sample OSM extract
assets.evidence: none: the file has synthetic ids (1, 2, 3...), but its origin is not recorded
assets.remediation: record whether it is synthetic (then project-owned) or copied from OpenStreetMap (then ODbL, as places.json.gz)

assets.name: Finland start minimap
assets.purpose: the city menu's map of Finland
assets.origin: OpenStreetMap motorway, trunk and primary roads, drawn by tools/osm/build_finland_minimap.py from a local OSM PBF

assets.name: Railway timetable and train compositions
assets.origin: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi (GTFS and composition API), converted by the game's importers
assets.obligations: attribution 'Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, license CC 4.0 BY', indicate changes

assets.name: LAM traffic profiles
assets.purpose: measured hourly traffic curves for calibrating NPC traffic demand
assets.origin: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi TMS raw detections, aggregated to hourly shares by tools/lam_profiles.py
assets.obligations: attribution 'Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, license CC 4.0 BY', indicate changes

assets.name: Finnish resident names
assets.origin: DVV population information system name data (nimipalvelu.dvv.fi, avoindata.suomi.fi)
assets.copyright: Digital and Population Data Services Agency (DVV)

assets.name: Finnish municipalities
assets.purpose: city list, population, map picker settings
assets.obligations: attribution, indicate changes; the adapted data file stays CC BY-SA 4.0 (share-alike applies to the file, not to the game)
assets.commercial: yes, the file stays CC BY-SA
assets.remediation: attribution in Credits (done); legal review of share-alike scope advisable

assets.name: Liiga and Veikkausliiga fixtures
assets.copyright: Liiga, Veikkausliiga and their data providers (per DATA_LICENSES.txt)
assets.evidence: no terms of use found for redistribution
assets.remediation: obtain permission, or replace with a licensed source, or ship no dataset (bare facts fetched at runtime, subject to the services' terms); legal review

assets.name: Generated sound effects
assets.purpose: vehicle, weather, ambience, UI, sports and holiday sounds
assets.origin: generated with Stable Audio Open 1.0 (stabilityai/stable-audio-open-1.0) by tools/generate_audio.py
assets.licence: model licence not archived (believed to be the Stability AI Community License: unverified)
assets.obligations: per the model licence (revenue limits, attribution): to be confirmed
assets.commercial: unknown until the licence text is confirmed
assets.remediation: archive the model's licence text as accepted; confirm the commercial-use and attribution terms; legal review

assets.name: Station announcements
assets.origin: Chatterbox Multilingual TTS (ai-audio-studio) cloning the reference voice voices/female/eeva.wav
assets.obligations: consent of the person whose voice was cloned; Chatterbox model terms
assets.remediation: written consent from the speaker, or regenerate with a voice the project has rights to

assets.name: Chatter voices
assets.origin: text-to-speech: Microsoft Azure Speech (utils/ttsazure.py) and/or Chatterbox cloning voices/female/default.wav
assets.evidence: sounds/LICENSE; no per-file record of the tool or voice
assets.obligations: Azure Speech output terms; consent for any cloned reference voice
assets.remediation: record the tool and voice per file; confirm Microsoft's terms; consent for cloned voices

assets.name: Chatter lines
assets.remediation: confirm the lines were written for the game, not copied

assets.name: Menu music
assets.origin: generated locally with Stable Audio Open 1.0 through ai-audio-studio; seed 10212026, 100 inference steps; beat-aligned 16-bar Ogg Vorbis loop
assets.evidence: docs/audio/menu-music.json records the prompt, seed, model and loop processing
assets.remediation: verify the applicable Stable Audio Open model terms for generated-output redistribution (same model as the generated sound effects)

assets.name: Nightclub music
assets.origin: nightclub_dance_1/2: provided by the project owner on 2026-10-19 as MP3s, converted to Ogg Vorbis (q1, 44.1 kHz), generator not recorded; nightclub_house_3.ogg / nightclub_techno_4.ogg: generated 2026-10-19 with Stable Audio Open 1.0 (ai-audio-studio, seeds 7710042 / 3301977, 100 steps); industrial breakbeat loop reused from the generated menu track (Stable Audio Open 1.0, seed 10212026; docs/audio/menu-music.json); nightclub_eurodance_female_6/7: generated with ACE-Step 1.5 (acestep-v15-turbo, 5Hz LM 0.6B), original lyrics and synthetic female singing, seeds 106138 / 107146; see docs/audio/eurodance-nightclub.json
assets.remediation: record how the tracks were made (tool, model) and verify its terms for generated-output redistribution

assets.name: Car stereo music
assets.purpose: electro pop from NPC car stereos (godot/car_audio.gd)
assets.origin: cars_music_1/2: provided by the project owner on 2026-10-19 as MP3s, converted to Ogg Vorbis (q1, 44.1 kHz), generator not recorded; cars_bass_far_1/2.ogg: generated 2026-10-19 with Stable Audio Open 1.0 (ai-audio-studio, seeds 1928374 / 5550123, 100 steps), like the sound effects; industrial breakbeat loop reused from the generated menu track (Stable Audio Open 1.0, seed 10212026; docs/audio/menu-music.json)
assets.remediation: record how the tracks were made (tool, model) and verify its terms for generated-output redistribution

assets.name: Images and icons
assets.purpose: loading image, rage faces, people atlas, taxi icon, two-wheeler sprites
assets.remediation: record each image's origin (own work, bought, AI-generated with which service) and its licence or terms

pyinstaller.obligations: COPYING.txt (collect_licenses.py); the exception permits the built program under its own terms

Python runtime.obligations: python/LICENSE.txt; verify it lists the Windows build's bundled libraries

osmium-tool 1.19.1 and libraries.licence: GPL-3.0-only (osmium-tool); BSL-1.0, MIT, Zlib, bzip2, BSD-2-Clause, Microsoft runtime terms
osmium-tool 1.19.1 and libraries.obligations: licence texts in server/osmium/licenses; source and build recipe attached to each release

OpenStreetMap tile server (tile.openstre.obligations: attribution (shown); the OSMF tile usage policy limits heavy use: review for a commercial release

Nominatim (nominatim.openstreetmap.org).obligations: the Nominatim usage policy (1 request/s, identifying User-Agent, no heavy use): review for a commercial release

Overpass API (overpass-api.de, overpass..obligations: ODbL attribution (shown); each server's usage policy

Digitraffic (tie.digitraffic.fi).use: live roadworks, when the realtime road data setting is on
Digitraffic (tie.digitraffic.fi).obligations: CC BY 4.0 attribution (shown under Roadworks in Credits); the service's usage terms
